objects.description: This header only defines preprocessor macros for symbol visibility and deprecation. It does not declare or define any structs, enums, typedefs, or classes. Therefore, there are no custom data types to extract. The listed aliases are macros, not types, and are included here only to clarify that no actual C/C++ type definitions exist in this file.
Result code type returned by most API functions. 0 indicates success; any non-zero value indicates an error. It is a 32-bit unsigned integer.
Opaque handle for the top-level librnp context (FFI). Owns keyrings, callbacks, and operation objects created under it.
Opaque handle referencing a specific OpenPGP key (primary or subkey). Used to query/manipulate keys, export, protect, etc.
Opaque input stream handle used by the API to read data from files, memory, stdin, or callbacks.
Opaque output stream handle used by the API to write data to files, memory, stdout, armor wrappers, null sink, or callbacks.
Opaque context for key or subkey generation operations. Configure parameters then execute.
Opaque context for data signing operations (embedded, cleartext, detached).
Opaque per-signature configuration object used with signing or encrypt-and-sign operations.
Opaque context for verification/decryption operations. Execute to process data, then query results.
Opaque handle representing a single signature result within a verify operation.
Opaque context for encryption (and optional signing) operations.
Opaque iterator over identifiers (userid, keyid, grip, fingerprint) from an FFI’s keyrings.
Opaque handle for a specific user ID entry attached to a key.
Opaque handle for a key/userid/document signature entity. Used for creation, inspection, export, and deletion.
Opaque handle for a parsed signature subpacket within a signature.
Opaque handle exposing recipient info (public-key recipient) from a verified/decrypted message.
Opaque handle exposing password-based encryption entry used in a message.

objects.definition: typedef bool rnp_input_reader_t(void *app_ctx, void *buf, size_t len, size_t *read);
objects.description: Function type for input read callbacks. Returns true on success (including EOF with 0 bytes).
Function type for input close callbacks.

objects.definition: typedef bool rnp_output_writer_t(void *app_ctx, const void *buf, size_t len);
objects.description: Function type for output write callbacks. Must return true only if all data written.
Function type for output close callbacks with a discard hint.
Callback type to provide passwords for key operations and symmetric encryption/decryption.
Callback type invoked when a key is required but missing; application should load/import it.

objects.definition:
typedef void (*rnp_key_signatures_cb)(rnp_ffi_t              ffi,
                                      void *                 app_ctx,
                                      rnp_signature_handle_t sig,

objects.description: Callback type to inspect or decide removal/retention of signatures during rnp_key_remove_signatures.

functions.name: rnp_result_to_string
functions.description: Returns a constant, human-readable string that describes an rnp_result_t code. Useful for logging and error reporting.
requirements: result may be any rnp_result_t value.

functions.name: rnp_version_string
functions.description: Returns a short string with the library version. Intended for display/logging.

functions.name: rnp_version_string_full
functions.description: Returns a full, descriptive version string of the library (may include backend/build info). Intended for display/logging.

functions.name: rnp_version
functions.description: Returns a numeric value representing the librnp version. For non-release builds, returns 0. Can be compared using rnp_version_for().

functions.name: rnp_version_for
functions.signature: RNP_API uint32_t rnp_version_for(uint32_t major, uint32_t minor, uint32_t patch);
functions.description: Constructs a comparable numeric version value from major/minor/patch components.

functions.name: rnp_version_major
functions.description: Extracts the major version number from a packed version value (e.g., returned by rnp_version or rnp_version_for).

functions.name: rnp_version_minor
functions.description: Extracts the minor version number from a packed version value (e.g., returned by rnp_version or rnp_version_for).

functions.name: rnp_version_patch
functions.description: Extracts the patch version number from a packed version value (e.g., returned by rnp_version or rnp_version_for).

functions.name: rnp_version_commit_timestamp
functions.description: Returns a unix timestamp of the last commit for non-release builds; for releases returns 0.

functions.name: rnp_enable_debug
functions.description: Deprecated no-op: will silently return RNP_SUCCESS. Historically enabled internal debug logging for a file or 'all'.
requirements: file is a C-string; may be 'all' or a file name. Has no effect.

functions.name: rnp_disable_debug
functions.description: Deprecated no-op: will silently return RNP_SUCCESS. Historically disabled internal debug logging.

functions.name: rnp_ffi_create
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_ffi_create(rnp_ffi_t * ffi, const char *pub_format, const char *sec_format);
functions.description: Creates the top-level FFI object used to interact with librnp, selecting public/secret keystore formats.
requirements: ffi must not be NULL; on success *ffi is set.
pub_format must not be NULL; use a RNP_KEYSTORE_* constant.
sec_format must not be NULL; use a RNP_KEYSTORE_* constant.
Destroy with rnp_ffi_destroy() when done.

functions.name: rnp_ffi_destroy
functions.description: Destroys the FFI object and invalidates associated objects (key handles, keyrings, etc.).
requirements: ffi must be a valid FFI created by rnp_ffi_create.
After destroy, all derived handles are invalid and must not be used.

functions.name: rnp_ffi_set_log_fd
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_ffi_set_log_fd(rnp_ffi_t ffi, int fd);
functions.description: Sets the file descriptor used by librnp for logging output.
requirements: ffi must be a valid FFI.
fd must be a valid, open file descriptor for writing.

functions.name: rnp_ffi_set_key_provider
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_ffi_set_key_provider(rnp_ffi_t ffi, rnp_get_key_cb getkeycb, void * getkeycb_ctx);
functions.description: Registers a callback that librnp will use to request missing public/secret keys during operations (verification/decryption).
requirements: ffi must be initialized and not NULL.
getkeycb must be a valid function pointer; see rnp_get_key_cb for semantics.
getkeycb_ctx is an opaque pointer passed to the callback (may be NULL).

functions.name: rnp_ffi_set_pass_provider
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_ffi_set_pass_provider(rnp_ffi_t ffi, rnp_password_cb getpasscb, void * getpasscb_ctx);
functions.description: Registers a password provider callback used by librnp to request passwords for key operations or symmetric encryption/decryption.
requirements: ffi must be initialized and not NULL.
getpasscb must be a valid function pointer; see rnp_password_cb.
getpasscb_ctx is an opaque pointer passed to the callback (may be NULL).

functions.name: rnp_get_default_homedir
functions.description: Returns the default rnp homedir path (e.g., ~/.rnp) allocated by the library.
requirements: homedir must not be NULL; on success, free with rnp_buffer_destroy().

functions.name: rnp_detect_homedir_info
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_detect_homedir_info(const char *homedir, char **pub_format, char **pub_path, char **sec_format, char **sec_path);
functions.description: Detects formats and paths of homedir keyrings under a given homedir.
requirements: homedir must point to a path string.
pub_format/pub_path/sec_format/sec_path may be non-NULL; if set on success, free each with rnp_buffer_destroy().
Returns RNP_SUCCESS even if no known format found (outputs may be NULL).

functions.name: rnp_detect_key_format
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_detect_key_format(const uint8_t buf[], size_t buf_len, char **format);
functions.description: Detects the key format of provided key data (e.g., GPG/KBX/G10/OpenPGP).
requirements: buf must not be NULL.
buf_len must be > 0.
format must not be NULL; free with rnp_buffer_destroy() on success.

functions.name: rnp_calculate_iterations
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_calculate_iterations(const char *hash, size_t msec, size_t *iterations);
functions.description: Estimates an S2K iteration count for a given hash to target approximately the specified derivation time on the current system.
requirements: hash must be a supported hash name string.
msec specifies target milliseconds; must be reasonable (>=1 recommended).
iterations must not be NULL; receives approximate iteration count.

functions.name: rnp_supports_feature
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_supports_feature(const char *type, const char *name, bool *supported);
functions.description: Checks whether a specific feature value (e.g., algorithm, curve) is supported by librnp.
requirements: type must be a valid feature type string (see RNP_FEATURE_*).
name must be the feature value to check.
supported must not be NULL.

functions.name: rnp_supported_features
functions.description: Returns a JSON array (string) of supported feature values for a given type.
requirements: type must be a valid feature type string.
result must not be NULL; free with rnp_buffer_destroy() on success.

functions.name: rnp_add_security_rule
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_add_security_rule(rnp_ffi_t ffi, const char *type, const char *name, uint32_t flags, uint64_t from, uint32_t level);
functions.description: Adds a security rule to override default algorithm security behavior (e.g., mark some algorithms insecure/prohibited) with optional scoping and effective-time.
requirements: ffi must be initialized and not NULL.
type must not be NULL (currently only RNP_FEATURE_HASH_ALG supported).
name must be a supported feature value string.
flags may include RNP_SECURITY_OVERRIDE/VERIFY_KEY/VERIFY_DATA.
from is a timestamp for rule activation.
level must be one of RNP_SECURITY_PROHIBITED/INSECURE/DEFAULT.
Change rules before loading keyrings or reload after changes (per notes).

functions.name: rnp_get_security_rule
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_get_security_rule(rnp_ffi_t ffi, const char *type, const char *name, uint64_t time, uint32_t *flags, uint64_t *from, uint32_t *level);
functions.description: Retrieves the effective security rule for a feature value at a given timestamp, optionally filtered by usage, returning flags/from/level.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
type and name must identify the feature value.
time is the timestamp to query.
flags may be NULL; if non-NULL, initialize *flags to desired usage restriction (0 or a single usage flag).
from may be NULL; level must not be NULL.

functions.name: rnp_remove_security_rule
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_remove_security_rule(rnp_ffi_t ffi, const char *type, const char *name, uint32_t level, uint32_t flags, uint64_t from, size_t *removed);
functions.description: Removes security rule(s) matching the parameters; can clear defaults if used broadly. Use with caution.
requirements: ffi must be initialized and not NULL.
type may be NULL to clear all rules.
name may be NULL to clear all rules of the type.
flags may include RNP_SECURITY_OVERRIDE, RNP_SECURITY_VERIFY_KEY, RNP_SECURITY_VERIFY_DATA, RNP_SECURITY_REMOVE_ALL.
from is used unless RNP_SECURITY_REMOVE_ALL is specified.
removed may be NULL; if non-NULL returns number of rules removed.

functions.name: rnp_request_password
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_request_password(rnp_ffi_t ffi, rnp_key_handle_t key, const char * context, char ** password);
functions.description: Requests a password via the FFI’s configured password provider for a given context and optional key, returning an allocated password buffer.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
key may be NULL; if provided, do not retain beyond callback semantics.
context describes purpose; may be a predefined or custom string.
password must not be NULL; free with rnp_buffer_destroy(); consider rnp_buffer_clear() for secure wipe.

functions.name: rnp_set_timestamp
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_set_timestamp(rnp_ffi_t ffi, uint64_t time);
functions.description: Overrides system time used by operations (generation/verification) for the FFI lifetime. Pass 0 to restore system time.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
time is a non-zero timestamp to override; 0 restores default.

functions.name: rnp_load_keys
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_load_keys(rnp_ffi_t ffi, const char *format, rnp_input_t input, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Loads keys from the given input into the FFI keyrings using the specified format.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
format must not be NULL (RNP_KEYSTORE_*).
input must be a valid, opened input. For G10, input must be a directory that exists.
flags is a combination of RNP_LOAD_SAVE_*.

functions.name: rnp_unload_keys
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_unload_keys(rnp_ffi_t ffi, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Unloads public and/or secret keys from the FFI. All key handles become invalid and must be destroyed.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
flags must specify which keys to unload (RNP_KEY_UNLOAD_PUBLIC/SECRET).
Do not use any key handles after unloading; destroy them.

functions.name: rnp_import_keys
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_import_keys(rnp_ffi_t ffi, rnp_input_t input, uint32_t flags, char ** results);
functions.description: Imports OpenPGP keys from input into the keyring, optionally returning a JSON summary of new/updated keys.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
input cannot be NULL.
flags: combination of RNP_LOAD_SAVE_* (PERMISSIVE, SINGLE, BASE64 have special semantics).
results may be NULL; if non-NULL, free with rnp_buffer_destroy() on success.
May return RNP_ERROR_EOF when RNP_LOAD_SAVE_SINGLE is set and the last key was read.

functions.name: rnp_import_signatures
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_import_signatures(rnp_ffi_t ffi, rnp_input_t input, uint32_t flags, char ** results);
functions.description: Imports standalone signatures into the keyring, optionally returning a JSON summary of updates.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
input cannot be NULL.
flags currently must be 0.
results may be NULL; if non-NULL, free with rnp_buffer_destroy().

functions.name: rnp_save_keys
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_save_keys(rnp_ffi_t ffi, const char * format, rnp_output_t output, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Saves FFI keyrings to the specified output in the given format.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
format must not be NULL (RNP_KEYSTORE_*).
output must be a valid, opened output. For G10, output must be a pre-existing directory.
flags is a combination of RNP_LOAD_SAVE_*.

functions.name: rnp_get_public_key_count
functions.description: Returns the number of public keys loaded in the FFI.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
count must not be NULL.

functions.name: rnp_get_secret_key_count
functions.description: Returns the number of secret keys loaded in the FFI.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
count must not be NULL.

functions.name: rnp_locate_key
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_locate_key(rnp_ffi_t ffi, const char * identifier_type, const char * identifier, rnp_key_handle_t *key);
functions.description: Searches for a key by userid, keyid, fingerprint, or grip and returns a key handle or NULL if not found.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
identifier_type must be one of: userid, keyid, fingerprint, grip.
identifier must be a userid string for 'userid' or hex string for others.
key must not be NULL; on success may be set to NULL if not found; destroy with rnp_key_handle_destroy() when done.
Only valid userids are considered when searching by userid.

functions.name: rnp_key_handle_destroy
functions.description: Destroys a key handle previously obtained from the API.
requirements: key may be NULL (behavior unspecified by comment); pass a valid handle to destroy.

functions.name: rnp_generate_key_json
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_generate_key_json(rnp_ffi_t ffi, const char *json, char **results);
functions.description: Generates a primary key and optionally a subkey from a JSON description and returns JSON results with key grips.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
json must not be NULL and must follow the documented schema.
results must not be NULL; free with rnp_buffer_destroy() on success.
Pass provider may be required if protection is requested.

functions.name: rnp_generate_key_rsa
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_generate_key_rsa(rnp_ffi_t ffi, uint32_t bits, uint32_t subbits, const char * userid, const char * password, rnp_key_handle_t *key);
functions.description: Shortcut to generate an RSA primary key and RSA subkey with specified sizes, userid, and optional protection password.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
userid must not be NULL.
bits/subbits are RSA key sizes in bits; 0 may use defaults.
password may be NULL (key unencrypted).
key may be NULL; if non-NULL receives primary key handle to destroy with rnp_key_handle_destroy().

functions.name: rnp_generate_key_dsa_eg
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_generate_key_dsa_eg(rnp_ffi_t ffi, uint32_t bits, uint32_t subbits, const char * userid, const char * password, rnp_key_handle_t *key);
functions.description: Shortcut to generate DSA primary key and ElGamal subkey with the given sizes, userid, and optional password.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
userid must not be NULL.
bits/subbits are sizes; 0 may use defaults.
password may be NULL.
key may be NULL; if non-NULL destroy handle with rnp_key_handle_destroy().

functions.name: rnp_generate_key_ec
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_generate_key_ec(rnp_ffi_t ffi, const char * curve, const char * userid, const char * password, rnp_key_handle_t *key);
functions.description: Shortcut to generate an ECDSA primary key and ECDH subkey for the given curve, userid, and optional password.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
curve must be a supported curve string.
userid must not be NULL.
password may be NULL.
key may be NULL; if non-NULL destroy handle with rnp_key_handle_destroy().

functions.name: rnp_generate_key_25519
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_generate_key_25519(rnp_ffi_t ffi, const char * userid, const char * password, rnp_key_handle_t *key);
functions.description: Shortcut to generate an EdDSA/X25519 keypair (EdDSA primary, x25519 subkey) with userid and optional password.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
userid must not be NULL.
password may be NULL.
key may be NULL; if non-NULL destroy handle with rnp_key_handle_destroy().

functions.name: rnp_generate_key_sm2
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_generate_key_sm2(rnp_ffi_t ffi, const char * userid, const char * password, rnp_key_handle_t *key);
functions.description: Shortcut to generate SM2 primary/subkey pair with userid and optional password.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
userid must not be NULL.
password may be NULL.
key may be NULL; if non-NULL destroy handle with rnp_key_handle_destroy().

functions.name: rnp_generate_key_ex
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_generate_key_ex(rnp_ffi_t ffi, const char * key_alg, const char * sub_alg, uint32_t key_bits, uint32_t sub_bits, const char * key_curve, const char * sub_curve, const char * userid, const char * password, rnp_key_handle_t *key);
functions.description: Generic shortcut for key generation, selecting algorithms, sizes/curves, userid, and optional secret protection.
requirements: ffi must be initialized.
key_alg must not be NULL; must be able to sign for primary.
sub_alg may be NULL to skip subkey.
key_bits/sub_bits must be zero for EC-based algorithms (use curves).
key_curve/sub_curve must be non-NULL only for matching EC-based algorithms.
userid cannot be NULL.
password may be NULL (no protection).
key may be NULL; if non-NULL destroy handle with rnp_key_handle_destroy().

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_create
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_op_generate_create(rnp_op_generate_t *op, rnp_ffi_t ffi, const char * alg);
functions.description: Creates a key-generation operation context for a primary key of a signing-capable algorithm.
requirements: op must not be NULL; receives context.
ffi must be initialized.
alg must be a supported signing algorithm string ('rsa','dsa','ecdsa','eddsa','sm2').
Pass provider is required if generated key needs protection.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_subkey_create
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_op_generate_subkey_create(rnp_op_generate_t *op, rnp_ffi_t ffi, rnp_key_handle_t primary, const char * alg);
functions.description: Creates a key-generation operation context for a subkey, under an existing primary key.
requirements: op must not be NULL.
ffi must be initialized.
primary must be a key handle with secret part.
If primary is encrypted/locked, a pass provider is needed.
alg must be a supported algorithm string ('rsa','dsa','elgamal','ecdsa','eddsa','ecdh','sm2').

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_set_bits
functions.description: Sets key size in bits for RSA/DSA/ElGamal generation context.
requirements: op must be a valid generate context.
bits must be appropriate for the selected algorithm (non-EC).

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_set_hash
functions.description: Sets the hash algorithm for self-signature or subkey binding signature in generation context.
requirements: op must be valid.
hash must be one of supported values: MD5, SHA1, RIPEMD160, SHA256, SHA384, SHA512, SHA224, SM3.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_set_dsa_qbits
functions.description: Sets size of DSA q parameter for DSA key generation (overrides default).
requirements: op must be valid.
qbits must be a sensible DSA q size.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_set_curve
functions.description: Sets the elliptic curve for ECC key generation (ECDSA/ECDH/SM2).
requirements: op must be valid.
curve must be a supported curve string (e.g., NIST P-256, ...).

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_set_protection_password
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_op_generate_set_protection_password(rnp_op_generate_t op, const char * password);
functions.description: Sets the password for secret key protection for the generated key. Without this, key will be unencrypted (unless password provider is used).
requirements: op must be valid.
password must be a non-NULL C-string. It is copied internally.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_set_request_password
functions.description: Enables/disables requesting a password via FFI’s password provider for key encryption if no explicit password is set.
requirements: op must be valid.
If a password was set via rnp_op_generate_set_protection_password(), this setting is ignored.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_set_protection_cipher
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_op_generate_set_protection_cipher(rnp_op_generate_t op, const char * cipher);
functions.description: Specifies cipher used to encrypt secret key data for generated key(s).
requirements: op must be valid.
cipher must be one of: Idea, Tripledes, Cast5, Blowfish, AES128, AES192, AES256, Twofish, Camellia128, Camellia192, Camellia256, SM4.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_set_protection_hash
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_op_generate_set_protection_hash(rnp_op_generate_t op, const char * hash);
functions.description: Specifies hash algorithm used for S2K derivation when protecting secret key data.
requirements: op must be valid.
hash must be a supported hash string.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_set_protection_mode
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_op_generate_set_protection_mode(rnp_op_generate_t op, const char * mode);
functions.description: Sets the protection mode for secret key encryption (mainly relevant for G10 format).
requirements: op must be valid.
mode must be one of: CFB, CBC, OCB.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_set_protection_iterations
functions.description: Sets the number of S2K iterations to derive the encryption key for secret-key protection.
requirements: op must be valid.
iterations should be a positive value; 0 uses a default.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_add_usage
functions.description: Adds a key usage flag (sign/certify/encrypt/authenticate) to override defaults.
requirements: op must be valid.
usage must be one of: sign, certify, encrypt, authenticate.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_clear_usage
functions.description: Clears customized usage flags so defaults will be used.
requirements: op must be valid.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_set_userid
functions.description: Sets the user ID for the primary key being generated.
requirements: op must be a primary-key generation context.
userid must be a NULL-terminated string.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_set_expiration
functions.description: Sets key/subkey expiration time in seconds (0 for no expiration).
requirements: op must be valid.
expiration is seconds since creation (0 means no expiry).

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_add_pref_hash
functions.description: Adds a preferred hash algorithm to primary key user preferences (priority by add order).
requirements: op must be a primary-key generation context.
hash must be a supported hash string.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_clear_pref_hashes
functions.description: Clears preferred hash algorithms list (defaults will be used).
requirements: op must be a primary-key generation context.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_add_pref_compression
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_op_generate_add_pref_compression(rnp_op_generate_t op, const char * compression);
functions.description: Adds a preferred compression algorithm to primary key user preferences (priority by add order).
requirements: op must be a primary-key generation context.
compression must be one of: zip, zlib, bzip2.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_clear_pref_compression
functions.description: Clears preferred compression algorithms list (defaults will be used).
requirements: op must be a primary-key generation context.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_add_pref_cipher
functions.description: Adds a preferred symmetric cipher to primary key user preferences (priority by add order).
requirements: op must be a primary-key generation context.
cipher must be a supported cipher string.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_clear_pref_ciphers
functions.description: Clears preferred symmetric ciphers list (defaults will be used).
requirements: op must be a primary-key generation context.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_set_pref_keyserver
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_op_generate_set_pref_keyserver(rnp_op_generate_t op, const char * keyserver);
functions.description: Sets the preferred key server URL in user preferences for the primary key (or clears it if NULL).
requirements: op must be a primary-key generation context.
keyserver may be NULL (to delete) or a URL string.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_set_v6_key
functions.description: Experimental: Marks the generated key version to v6. Subject to change/removal.
requirements: op must be valid.
Feature is experimental; API may change.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_set_sphincsplus_param
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_op_generate_set_sphincsplus_param(rnp_op_generate_t op, const char * param);
functions.description: Experimental: Sets SPHINCS+ parameter set for generation. Subject to change/removal.
requirements: op must be valid.
param must be one of: 128s, 128f, 192s, 192f, 256s, 256f.
Feature is experimental; API may change.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_execute
functions.description: Executes a prepared key or subkey generation operation.
requirements: op must be a valid generation context created earlier.
If protection algorithms were set and password is required, an FFI password provider must be configured.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_get_key
functions.description: Retrieves the generated key’s handle after successful execution.
requirements: op must have been successfully executed.
handle must not be NULL; destroy with rnp_key_handle_destroy() after use.

functions.name: rnp_op_generate_destroy
functions.description: Frees resources associated with a key-generation operation context.
requirements: op must be a context previously initialized with a rnp_op_generate_*_create function.

functions.name: rnp_key_export
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_key_export(rnp_key_handle_t key, rnp_output_t output, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Exports a key (public/secret, with optional armor) to the specified output based on flags.
requirements: key must be a valid key handle.
output must be a valid output stream.
flags is a combination of RNP_KEY_EXPORT_* controlling what to export.

functions.name: rnp_key_export_autocrypt
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_key_export_autocrypt(rnp_key_handle_t key, rnp_key_handle_t subkey, const char * uid, rnp_output_t output, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Exports a minimal autocrypt key (key, uid, self-sig, encryption subkey, binding sig). Optionally base64-encodes.
requirements: key must be a primary key handle, not NULL.
subkey may be NULL (first suitable is chosen) or a specific subkey.
uid may be NULL if only one uid exists, otherwise provide a uid.
output must be valid.
flags: currently only RNP_KEY_EXPORT_BASE64 is supported.

functions.name: rnp_key_export_revocation
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_key_export_revocation(rnp_key_handle_t key, rnp_output_t output, uint32_t flags, const char * hash, const char * code, const char * reason);
functions.description: Generates a primary key revocation signature and writes it to output (optionally armored).
requirements: key must be a primary key. If it does not have a secret part, the keyring must contain an authorized revocation key; if locked, password provider may be used.
output must be valid.
flags must be 0 or RNP_KEY_EXPORT_ARMORED.
hash may be NULL to use default.
code may be NULL (defaults to 'no'); allowed: 'no','superseded','compromised','retired'.
reason may be NULL or empty.

functions.name: rnp_key_revoke
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_key_revoke(rnp_key_handle_t key, uint32_t flags, const char * hash, const char * code, const char * reason);
functions.description: Revokes a key or subkey by generating and adding a revocation signature to the keyring.
requirements: key must be a key or subkey; for primary must have secret key or revoker secret in keyrings; for subkey, primary secret must be present. If secret is locked, password provider may be used.
flags currently must be 0.
hash may be NULL (default).
code: 'no','superseded','compromised','retired' or NULL.
reason optional.

functions.name: rnp_key_25519_bits_tweaked
functions.description: Checks whether a Curve25519 ECDH secret key has correctly tweaked low/high bits as per RFC 7748 sec. 5.
requirements: key must be an ECDH Curve25519 unlocked secret key handle, not NULL.
result must not be NULL.
Operation requires unlocked secret; consider rnp_key_lock() afterwards.

functions.name: rnp_key_25519_bits_tweak
functions.description: Tweaks the least/most significant bits of a Curve25519 secret key to correct values (RFC 7748).
requirements: key must be an ECDH Curve25519 unprotected (unlocked and unencrypted) secret key handle, not NULL.
Operation modifies secret key data; protect afterwards with rnp_key_protect().

functions.name: rnp_key_remove
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_key_remove(rnp_key_handle_t key, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Removes a key from keyring(s); optionally also removes its subkeys. Requires saving to persist.
requirements: key must be a valid key handle pointing to a key in keyrings.
flags: RNP_KEY_REMOVE_PUBLIC/SECRET/SUBKEYS (SUBKEYS only for primary).
After removal, other handles of the same key must not be used.
Call rnp_save_keys() to persist changes.

functions.name: rnp_key_remove_signatures
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_key_remove_signatures(rnp_key_handle_t key, uint32_t flags, rnp_key_signatures_cb sigcb, void * app_ctx);
functions.description: Removes unneeded signatures from a key, its userids, and subkeys based on filter flags; optional callback can override/record removals.
requirements: key must not be NULL.

flags control matching: may include RNP_KEY_SIGNATURE_INVALID, RNP_KEY_SIGNATURE_UNKNOWN_KEY, RNP_KEY_SIGNATURE_NON_SELF_SIG. If NON_SELF_SIG is not set, function may validate signatures and look up signer via key provider.
sigcb may be NULL; app_ctx passed through.
After call, any signature handles related to this key (uids/subkeys) should not be used.
Call rnp_save_keys() to persist changes.

functions.name: rnp_guess_contents
functions.description: Peeks an input stream to guess OpenPGP data contents type (message/public key/secret key/signature/unknown).
requirements: input must be opened and not NULL.
contents must not be NULL; free with rnp_buffer_destroy().

functions.name: rnp_enarmor
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_enarmor(rnp_input_t input, rnp_output_t output, const char *type);
functions.description: Adds ASCII armor to data read from input and writes armored data to output. Type may be specified or auto-guessed (NULL).
requirements: input must be a valid input stream.
output must be a valid output stream.
type may be one of 'message','public key','secret key','signature','cleartext' or NULL to guess.

functions.name: rnp_dearmor
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_dearmor(rnp_input_t input, rnp_output_t output);
functions.description: Removes ASCII armor from armored input and writes raw data to output.
requirements: input must be a valid input stream with armored data.
output must be a valid output stream.

functions.name: rnp_key_get_primary_uid
functions.description: Returns the key’s primary user id string. A userid is primary if marked so in a valid self-certification; otherwise the first valid uid is returned. Caller must free the returned string with rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: key must be a valid rnp_key_handle_t
uid must be non-NULL and will receive an allocated string to be freed via rnp_buffer_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_key_get_uid_count
functions.description: Returns the number of user IDs on the key.
requirements: key must be a valid rnp_key_handle_t
count must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_key_get_uid_at
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_key_get_uid_at(rnp_key_handle_t key, size_t idx, char **uid);
functions.description: Gets the user ID string at the given zero-based index. Caller must free the returned string with rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: key must be valid
idx is zero-based and must be within range [0, uid_count)
uid must be non-NULL and freed with rnp_buffer_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_key_get_uid_handle_at
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_key_get_uid_handle_at(rnp_key_handle_t  key, size_t            idx, rnp_uid_handle_t *uid);
functions.description: Returns a handle for the user ID at the given index. The handle must be destroyed with rnp_uid_handle_destroy().
requirements: key must be valid
idx must be in range [0, uid_count)
uid must be non-NULL and later destroyed via rnp_uid_handle_destroy()
Note: UID handle may become invalid after the user id or key is removed

functions.name: rnp_uid_get_type
functions.description: Retrieves the UID type: RNP_USER_ID (text UID) or RNP_USER_ATTR (photo).
requirements: uid must be a valid rnp_uid_handle_t
type must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_uid_get_data
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_uid_get_data(rnp_uid_handle_t uid, void **data, size_t *size);
functions.description: Returns raw UID data (format depends on UID type). Caller must free returned buffer with rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: uid must be valid
data must be non-NULL and will receive an allocated buffer to be freed with rnp_buffer_destroy()
size must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_uid_is_primary
functions.description: Reports whether this UID is marked as primary.
requirements: uid must be valid
primary must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_uid_is_valid
functions.description: Returns whether the UID is valid (key is valid and there is at least one valid, non-expired self-certification).
requirements: uid must be valid
valid must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_key_get_signature_count
functions.description: Returns the number of signatures directly on the key object (not UID certifications). For a primary key: direct-key and revocation; for a subkey: subkey bindings/revocations.
requirements: key must be valid
count must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_key_get_signature_at
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_key_get_signature_at(rnp_key_handle_t        key, size_t                  idx, rnp_signature_handle_t *sig);
functions.description: Gets the key’s signature handle at index. Caller must destroy the signature handle with rnp_signature_handle_destroy().
requirements: key must be valid
idx must be in range [0, count)
sig must be non-NULL and later destroyed via rnp_signature_handle_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_key_direct_signature_create
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_key_direct_signature_create(rnp_key_handle_t        signer, rnp_key_handle_t        target, rnp_signature_handle_t *sig);
functions.description: Creates a new direct-key signature to be issued by signer over target (or self-signature if target is NULL). Customize via rnp_key_signature_set_* and finalize via rnp_key_signature_sign().
requirements: signer must be a secret key existing in the keyring up to signing
sig must be non-NULL and will receive a handle
target may be NULL for self-signature

functions.name: rnp_key_certification_create
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_key_certification_create(rnp_key_handle_t        signer, rnp_uid_handle_t        uid, const char *            type, rnp_signature_handle_t *sig);
functions.description: Creates a (self)certification signature by signer for the given UID. Type may be one of RNP_CERTIFICATION_* or NULL for default. Customize then sign via rnp_key_signature_sign().
requirements: signer must be a secret key existing in the keyring up to signing
uid must be a valid rnp_uid_handle_t and not NULL
type may be NULL or a supported certification type string
sig must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_key_revocation_signature_create
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_key_revocation_signature_create(rnp_key_handle_t        signer, rnp_key_handle_t        target, rnp_signature_handle_t *sig);
functions.description: Creates a key or subkey revocation signature by signer (target may be NULL to revoke signer). Customize then sign via rnp_key_signature_sign().
requirements: signer must be a secret key existing in the keyring up to signing
sig must be non-NULL
target may be NULL to revoke signer

functions.name: rnp_key_signature_set_hash
functions.description: Sets the hash algorithm to use for the editable key signature before signing.
requirements: sig must be a signature handle created via rnp_key_*_signature_create()
hash must be a supported hash algorithm string (e.g., SHA256)

functions.name: rnp_key_signature_set_creation
functions.description: Overrides the signature creation timestamp for an editable key signature.
requirements: sig must be editable (created via rnp_key_*_signature_create())

functions.name: rnp_key_signature_set_key_flags
functions.description: Sets key usage flags in the signature (maps to OpenPGP key flags).
requirements: sig must be editable (created via rnp_key_*_signature_create())
flags are OR'ed RNP_KEY_USAGE_* values; RNP does not validate applicability to the key type

functions.name: rnp_key_signature_set_key_expiration
functions.description: Sets key expiration (seconds since key creation) for self-certification or direct-key signatures.
requirements: sig must be editable (created via rnp_key_*_signature_create())
expiry is seconds since key creation; 0 means never expires

functions.name: rnp_key_signature_set_features
functions.description: Sets key feature flags (e.g., RNP_KEY_FEATURE_MDC, AEAD, V5) in a self-signature.
requirements: sig must be editable (created via rnp_key_*_signature_create())
features is OR'ed RNP_KEY_FEATURE_* flags

functions.name: rnp_key_signature_add_preferred_alg
functions.description: Adds a preferred symmetric algorithm to the signature preferences (order determines priority).
requirements: sig must be editable
alg must be a supported symmetric algorithm string

functions.name: rnp_key_signature_add_preferred_hash
functions.description: Adds a preferred hash algorithm to the signature preferences (order determines priority).
requirements: sig must be editable
hash must be a supported hash algorithm string

functions.name: rnp_key_signature_add_preferred_zalg
functions.description: Adds a preferred compression algorithm to the signature preferences (order determines priority).
requirements: sig must be editable
zalg must be one of supported compression algorithms (zip, zlib, bzip2)

functions.name: rnp_key_signature_set_primary_uid
functions.description: Marks the corresponding UID as primary (for self-certification).
requirements: sig must be editable and represent a self-certification

functions.name: rnp_key_signature_set_key_server
functions.description: Sets or clears the key server URL in the signature.
requirements: sig must be editable
keyserver may be NULL or empty to remove the field

functions.name: rnp_key_signature_set_key_server_prefs
functions.description: Sets key server preferences flags (currently RNP_KEY_SERVER_NO_MODIFY).
requirements: sig must be editable
flags is OR'ed preferences flags (currently only RNP_KEY_SERVER_NO_MODIFY)

functions.name: rnp_key_signature_set_revocation_reason
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_key_signature_set_revocation_reason(rnp_signature_handle_t sig, const char *code, const char *reason);
functions.description: Sets revocation reason code and textual reason for a revocation signature.
requirements: sig must be editable and a revocation-type signature
code may be NULL to use default; reason may be NULL or empty

functions.name: rnp_key_signature_set_revoker
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_key_signature_set_revoker(rnp_signature_handle_t sig, rnp_key_handle_t revoker, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Adds a designated revoker subpacket. Subsequent calls overwrite. Flags may include RNP_REVOKER_SENSITIVE.
requirements: sig must be editable
revoker must be a key handle
flags may include RNP_REVOKER_SENSITIVE

functions.name: rnp_key_signature_set_trust_level
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_key_signature_set_trust_level(rnp_signature_handle_t sig, uint8_t level, uint8_t amount);
functions.description: Sets 'Trust Signature' level and amount for a certification of another key.
requirements: sig must be editable; makes sense for other key’s certification
level and amount are 0..255

functions.name: rnp_key_signature_sign
functions.description: Finalizes and signs the editable key signature, adding it to the corresponding key.
requirements: sig must be created via rnp_key_*_signature_create() and configured as needed
Signer’s secret key must be available (and unlocked if protected)

functions.name: rnp_key_get_revoker_count
functions.description: Gets the number of designated revokers for the key.
requirements: key must be valid
count must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_key_get_revoker_at
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_key_get_revoker_at(rnp_key_handle_t key, size_t idx, char **revoker);
functions.description: Gets the designated revoker’s fingerprint (hex) at index. Caller frees with rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: key must be valid
idx must be within range
revoker must be non-NULL and freed with rnp_buffer_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_key_get_revocation_signature
functions.description: Returns the key’s revocation signature handle if present (NULL otherwise). Caller must destroy with rnp_signature_handle_destroy().
requirements: key must be valid
sig must be non-NULL; may be set to NULL if no valid revocation signature exists

functions.name: rnp_uid_get_signature_count
functions.description: Gets number of signatures attached to the given UID.
requirements: uid must be valid
count must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_uid_get_signature_at
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_uid_get_signature_at(rnp_uid_handle_t        uid, size_t                  idx, rnp_signature_handle_t *sig);
functions.description: Gets UID’s signature handle at index. Caller must destroy via rnp_signature_handle_destroy().
requirements: uid must be valid
idx must be within range
sig must be non-NULL and later destroyed with rnp_signature_handle_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_type
functions.description: Returns textual signature type (e.g., 'binary', 'text', 'direct', etc.). Caller must free string with rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: sig must be valid
type must be non-NULL and freed via rnp_buffer_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_alg
functions.description: Returns signature’s public key algorithm name. Caller must free with rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: sig must be valid
alg must be non-NULL and freed with rnp_buffer_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_hash_alg
functions.description: Returns signature’s hash algorithm name. Caller must free with rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: sig must be valid
alg must be non-NULL and freed with rnp_buffer_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_creation
functions.description: Returns the signature creation time (seconds since epoch).
requirements: sig must be valid
create must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_signature_subpacket_count
functions.description: Gets the number of subpackets contained in the signature.
requirements: sig must be valid
count must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_signature_subpacket_at
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_signature_subpacket_at(rnp_signature_handle_t sig, size_t idx, rnp_sig_subpacket_t *  subpkt);
functions.description: Returns a handle to the subpacket at the given index. Caller must destroy with rnp_signature_subpacket_destroy().
requirements: sig must be valid
idx must be within range; RNP_ERROR_NOT_FOUND if out of bounds
subpkt must be non-NULL and later destroyed with rnp_signature_subpacket_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_signature_subpacket_find
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_signature_subpacket_find(rnp_signature_handle_t sig, uint8_t type, bool hashed, size_t skip, rnp_sig_subpacket_t *  subpkt);
functions.description: Finds a subpacket of a given type, optionally restricted to hashed area, skipping a number of matches. Returns subpacket handle or RNP_ERROR_NOT_FOUND.
requirements: sig must be valid
subpkt must be non-NULL and later destroyed with rnp_signature_subpacket_destroy()
hashed controls search area; skip specifies how many matches to skip

functions.name: rnp_signature_subpacket_info
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_signature_subpacket_info(rnp_sig_subpacket_t subpkt, uint8_t *type, bool *hashed, bool *critical);
functions.description: Retrieves subpacket metadata: type, whether hashed/unhashed, and critical bit.
requirements: subpkt must be valid
type, hashed, critical pointers should be non-NULL if corresponding info is needed

functions.name: rnp_signature_subpacket_data
functions.description: Returns raw subpacket data. Caller must free data buffer via rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: subpkt must be valid
data must be non-NULL and freed with rnp_buffer_destroy()
size must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_signature_subpacket_destroy
functions.description: Destroys a signature subpacket handle.
requirements: subpkt must be a valid handle (cannot be NULL)

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_expiration
functions.description: Returns signature expiration time (seconds after creation), or 0 if non-expiring.
requirements: sig must be valid
expires must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_features
functions.description: Returns key feature flags from a self-signature: OR’ed RNP_KEY_FEATURE_* bits, or 0 if unavailable.
requirements: sig must be valid
features must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_preferred_alg_count
functions.description: Returns the count of preferred symmetric algorithms listed in the (self-)signature.
requirements: sig must be valid
count must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_preferred_alg
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_signature_get_preferred_alg(rnp_signature_handle_t sig, size_t idx, char **alg);
functions.description: Returns the name of the preferred symmetric algorithm at index. Caller frees with rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: sig must be valid
idx must be in range [0, count)
alg must be non-NULL and freed with rnp_buffer_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_preferred_hash_count
functions.description: Returns the count of preferred hash algorithms listed in the (self-)signature.
requirements: sig must be valid
count must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_preferred_hash
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_signature_get_preferred_hash(rnp_signature_handle_t sig, size_t idx, char **alg);
functions.description: Returns the preferred hash algorithm at index. Caller frees with rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: sig must be valid
idx must be in range
alg must be non-NULL and freed with rnp_buffer_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_preferred_zalg_count
functions.description: Returns the count of preferred compression algorithms listed in the (self-)signature.
requirements: sig must be valid
count must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_preferred_zalg
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_signature_get_preferred_zalg(rnp_signature_handle_t sig, size_t idx, char **alg);
functions.description: Returns the preferred compression algorithm at index. Caller frees with rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: sig must be valid
idx must be in range
alg must be non-NULL and freed with rnp_buffer_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_key_flags
functions.description: Returns key usage flags from the signature (OR’ed RNP_KEY_USAGE_*), or 0 if not available.
requirements: sig must be valid
flags must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_key_expiration
functions.description: Returns key expiration value from the signature (seconds since key creation), or 0 if key never expires.
requirements: sig must be valid
expiry must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_primary_uid
functions.description: Reports whether the signature indicates the corresponding UID is primary.
requirements: sig must be valid
primary must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_key_server
functions.description: Returns key server URL associated with the key in this signature, or an empty string if not present. Caller frees with rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: sig must be valid
keyserver must be non-NULL and freed with rnp_buffer_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_key_server_prefs
functions.description: Returns key server preference flags (currently RNP_KEY_SERVER_NO_MODIFY) if any.
requirements: sig must be valid
flags must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_keyid
functions.description: Returns signer’s keyid as hex string, or NULL if not available. Caller must free with rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: sig must be valid
result must be non-NULL and freed with rnp_buffer_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_key_fprint
functions.description: Returns signer’s fingerprint as hex string, or NULL if not available. Caller frees with rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: sig must be valid
result must be non-NULL and freed with rnp_buffer_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_signer
functions.description: Returns a handle to the signer’s key if available, else NULL. Caller must destroy the handle with rnp_key_handle_destroy().
requirements: sig must be valid
key must be non-NULL; may receive NULL if signer not available

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_revoker
functions.description: Returns fingerprint of a designated revocation key if present, else an empty string. Caller frees with rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: sig must be valid
revoker must be non-NULL and freed with rnp_buffer_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_revocation_reason
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_signature_get_revocation_reason(rnp_signature_handle_t sig, char **                code, char **                reason);
functions.description: Returns revocation reason code and text if present; otherwise empty strings. Caller frees both with rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: sig must be valid
code must be non-NULL and freed with rnp_buffer_destroy()
reason may be NULL; if non-NULL must be freed with rnp_buffer_destroy()

functions.name: rnp_signature_get_trust_level
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_signature_get_trust_level(rnp_signature_handle_t sig, uint8_t *              level, uint8_t *              amount);
functions.description: Returns trust signature level and amount if present (else 0).
requirements: sig must be valid
level and amount may be NULL; if non-NULL they receive values

functions.name: rnp_signature_is_valid
functions.description: Validates a signature (document, key, or uid). Returns a status code indicating validity or specific failure; flags may include RNP_SIGNATURE_REVALIDATE to force revalidation.
requirements: sig must be valid
flags must be supported; RNP_SIGNATURE_REVALIDATE may be used

functions.name: rnp_signature_error_count
functions.description: Returns the number of validation errors recorded for a signature (after validation).
requirements: sig must be valid
count must be non-NULL
Note: returns RNP_ERROR_VERIFICATION_FAILED if signature was not validated

functions.name: rnp_signature_error_at
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_signature_error_at(rnp_signature_handle_t sig, size_t idx, rnp_result_t *         error);
functions.description: Returns the error code at a given error index (see rnp_signature_error_count()).
requirements: sig must be valid
idx must be less than the count returned by rnp_signature_error_count()
error must be non-NULL

functions.name: rnp_signature_packet_to_json
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_signature_packet_to_json(rnp_signature_handle_t sig, uint32_t               flags, char **                json);
functions.description: Dumps the signature packet to a JSON string. Optional flags include RNP_JSON_DUMP_MPI and others. Caller frees JSON with rnp_buffer_destroy().
requirements: sig must be valid
json must be non-NULL and freed with rnp_buffer_destroy()

functions.description: Creates an encryption operation context for streaming encryption (optionally with signing).
requirements: op must be non-NULL
ffi must be initialized
input must be valid
output must be valid

functions.name: rnp_op_encrypt_add_recipient
functions.description: Adds a recipient’s public key to the encryption context.
requirements: op must be initialized
key must be a public key suitable for encryption (library does not validate validity/expiration)

functions.name: rnp_op_encrypt_enable_pkesk_v6
functions.description: Experimental: Enables creation of PKESK v6 where supported (leading to SEIPDv2), depending on recipients’ capabilities.
requirements: Available only when RNP_EXPERIMENTAL_CRYPTO_REFRESH is defined
op must be initialized

functions.name: rnp_op_encrypt_prefer_pqc_enc_subkey
functions.description: Experimental: Prefer PQC encryption subkeys over non-PQC when choosing recipient subkeys.
requirements: Available only when RNP_EXPERIMENTAL_PQC is defined
op must be initialized

functions.name: rnp_op_encrypt_add_signature

functions.description: Adds a signing key so the encryption operation will also sign (encrypt-and-sign). Optionally returns per-signature handle.
requirements: op must be initialized
key must be a private key capable of signing
sig may be NULL; if provided, do not free separately

functions.name: rnp_op_encrypt_set_hash
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_op_encrypt_set_hash(rnp_op_encrypt_t op, const char *hash);
functions.description: Sets hash algorithm for signatures in encrypt-and-sign mode (can be overridden per signature).
requirements: op must be initialized
hash must be a supported hash name; some signature types may require specific lengths

functions.name: rnp_op_encrypt_set_creation_time
functions.description: Sets default signature creation time for encrypt-and-sign.
requirements: op must be initialized

functions.name: rnp_op_encrypt_set_expiration_time
functions.description: Sets default signature expiration (seconds since creation, 0 = no expiry) for encrypt-and-sign.
requirements: op must be initialized

functions.name: rnp_op_encrypt_add_password
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_op_encrypt_add_password(rnp_op_encrypt_t op, const char *     password, const char *     s2k_hash, size_t           iterations, const char *     s2k_cipher);
functions.description: Adds a passphrase for password-based encryption (multiple allowed). Derivation uses s2k_hash and iterations; s2k_cipher is the KEK cipher.

password may be NULL to request via password provider

iterations: 0 to auto-calc, otherwise will be adjusted to nearest encodable in [1024..0x3e00000]
s2k_cipher may be NULL or a supported cipher name

functions.name: rnp_op_encrypt_set_armor

requirements: op must be initialized

functions.name: rnp_op_encrypt_set_cipher
functions.description: Sets the content encryption cipher (IDEA, TRIPLEDES, CAST5, BLOWFISH, AES*, TWOFISH, CAMELLIA*, SM4).
requirements: op must be initialized
cipher must be a supported cipher string

functions.name: rnp_op_encrypt_set_aead
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_op_encrypt_set_aead(rnp_op_encrypt_t op, const char *alg);
functions.description: Sets AEAD algorithm to use ('None' to disable, 'OCB' to enable). 'EAX' is deprecated and should not be used.
requirements: op must be initialized
alg must be 'None' or a supported AEAD algorithm string

functions.name: rnp_op_encrypt_set_aead_bits
functions.description: Sets AEAD chunk size as number of bits (0..16).
requirements: op must be initialized
bits must be in range 0..16

functions.name: rnp_op_encrypt_set_compression

functions.description: Sets compression algorithm (Uncompressed, ZIP, ZLIB, BZip2) and level (0–9) for the inner data.
requirements: op must be initialized
compression must be supported
level must be 0..9

functions.name: rnp_op_encrypt_set_flags
functions.signature: RNP_API rnp_result_t rnp_op_encrypt_set_flags(rnp_op_encrypt_t op, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Sets additional encryption flags (OR of RNP_ENCRYPT_*). Currently supports RNP_ENCRYPT_NOWRAP (no literal data wrapping).
requirements: op must be initialized
flags must be supported RNP_ENCRYPT_* bits

functions.description: Sets internal file modification time (32-bit seconds since epoch) for the data.
requirements: op must be initialized
